'''R2-F1P''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid]]<ref name="R-series note" /> with [[Color|white]], silver, yellow, and orange plating and a black [[sensor]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> Like all [[R-series|R2]] [[astromech droid]]s, it stood 0.96 [[meter]]s tall and was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="R-series note" /> Its status indicator could be red or blue in color when on.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

In [[13 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events on [[Corellia]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', which includes R2-F1P's appearance, to [[13 BBY]].</ref> R2-F1P was present in [[Coronet City Spaceport|Coronet Spaceport]] in [[Coronet City]] on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]]. Following a security alert being sounded in the [[spaceport]] after a breach of the customs gates, the [[droid]] rolled past a [[human]] family being violently separated by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[stormtrooper]]s.<ref name="Solo" />

==Behind the scenes==
R2-F1P was created for the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology film]], ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo" /> The droid was first revealed prior to the film's release as part of a [[Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|''Star Wars: Droid Factory'']] toy set produced by [[Hasbro]] earlier in 2018.<ref name="RS-news">{{Rebelscum|url=story/front/New_Disney_Parks_Droid_Factory_Astromech_Set_Is_Out_180403.asp|text=New Disney Parks Droid Factory Astromech Set Is Out|author=David Martin|date=2018-04-04}}</ref>
